About

In summer 2026 I decided I wanted a calendar of all the daily correspondences, witch's wheel of the year sabbats (both Astrological and Celtic Calendar), major astrology dates (like sun/zodiac signs, new, quarter and full moons and retrogrades) that I utilize in my practice. I'm just someone who likes within' around the house and no real expert, so the calendar is linked to the sources from where I gathered my information.
I figured if I wanted that calendar, someone else may, too so I shared it with some other witchy folks online. Using the same logic, someone asked for an app. So the Hygge Hearth Witch's Wheel of the Year was created ✨
